CustomField.description:
The value in this field will be populated by a Price Rule. The value will then be used by Flow to populate the Day 1 ARR field, where Day 1 ARR equals Day 1 ARR Unadjusted + ARR Adjustment
10.8.2024 - Deprecated in favor of a rollup summary field. Jira ticket SS-9382
